name: pricing-card
title: Pricing Card
description: One subscription plan on a card: plan name with an optional commerce badge (such as Best value), a monthly/yearly billing toggle that swaps the price and states the yearly total and saving, a short list of what is included, and a lime subscribe button. Controlled or uncontrolled billing; onSubscribe receives the chosen period.

meta.use_when: You are showing a paid plan (such as Creator) on a pricing page or upgrade panel, with monthly and yearly prices, what it includes, and a button to subscribe; use one card per plan and badge only the best-value plan.
